titolo: KuroCat 5.1.2 released as free open‑source 3D/2D typing cat companion
descr: The latest KuroCat version adds AI integration, OBS transparent source and multi‑platform installers for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android.
paragrafi: The qianyiai/kurocat project posted version 5.1.2 on GitHub, offering a lightweight desktop typing cat pet for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android.
Built with Tauri v2 and Rust, the app runs as a single transparent, always‑on‑top window and includes six hand‑crafted cat skins plus a whale‑girl character.
Version 5.1.2 adds native OBS transparent browser source, a built‑in MCP server for AI‑generated cats, and one‑click integration with Claude, Codex, DeepSeek, WorkBuddy and other models.
Installers are provided as a 2.15 MB EXE for Windows 10/11, a 5.93 MB universal DMG for macOS 10.15+, and .deb/AppImage packages for x86_64 and ARM64 Linux distributions.
The release also introduces password‑privacy guard that automatically closes the cat’s eyes when typing passwords, and cross‑platform single‑instance protection.
perche: Its AI‑driven MCP service lets hobbyists experiment with custom pet avatars, while the OBS source makes it useful for streamers looking for low‑overhead visual overlays.
